## Why it matters in a crowd

<!-- Relay's constraints are unusual: no servers, no accounts, phones that pass
     on messages they cannot read, and batteries that have to last the evening.
     A feature that is obvious in a normal chat app may cost battery on every
     nearby device, or make its user more identifiable. Say what you think it
     costs. -->
